meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: 装上后，当用户指定一个Pull Request，Claude会持续监控它的评论、审查和CI状态，检查未解决的问题，修复真实缺陷并提交，直到所有检查通过、无未解决评论，最后汇报具体证据（如最新提交号、检查结果）。
howto.when: 当你说出“babysit”“monitor”，或要求持续检查一个PR的评论、审查和CI直到问题解决时触发。

say.text: 帮我 babysit 这个 PR #42，直到可以合并
say.note: Claude 会持续检查并修复问题

say.text: 盯着这个 PR 的审查和 CI，有未解决评论就处理
say.note: 它会轮询检查并解决评论

say.text: 照看这个拉取请求，直到所有检查通过、评论清零

howto.what_en: Claude will continuously monitor a pull request, checking comments, reviews, and CI status until all actionable issues are resolved. It fixes real issues in focused commits, pushes, and reports evidence such as latest commit SHA and check results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked to babysit or monitor, or to keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Babysit PR #42 until it's ready to merge.
say_en.note: Claude polls checks and fixes issues as they appear.

say_en.text: Keep monitoring this pull request and resolve any review threads.
say_en.note: It will fix real issues and push commits.

say_en.text: Watch this PR, keep checking comments and CI until clean.
say_en.note: It reports final status with concrete evidence.
